title: Chunked SHA-256 checksum
hints: hashlib.sha256() gives an object; call .update(bytes) as many times as you like, then .hexdigest() once.
Loop: chunk = fileobj.read(chunk_size); stop when chunk is empty (b"" is falsy). Or use iter(lambda: f.read(n), b"").
Open the file with open(path, "rb") in a with block and hand the file object to sha256_stream.
For verify_checksum normalise expected: strip(), lower(), drop a leading "sha256:" and compare to sha256_file(path).
